rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things involving or extending across nations, including international organizations and cooperation.

example.english: This international organization has members in many countries.
example.traditional: 呢個國際組織喺好多國家都有成員
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 zai3 zou2 zik1 hai2 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 sing4 jyun4

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is worldwide scope or something common to people everywhere rather than relations between particular nations.

example.english: Climate change is an international issue.
example.traditional: 氣候變化係一個全球性問題
example.jyutping: hei3 hau6 bin3 faa3 hai6 jat1 go3 cyun4 kau4 sing3 man6 tai4
